purpose: S10-9b B2 historical DESKTOP comparator (one run, CP1 S10-9 allowance after the b2-desktop v2 set boot-smoked READY): the SHARED command subset of the S10-7 b2-headless schedule, driven through the retained real-GUI machinery (QMP input via the coordinated InputGate, screendump, glyph-oracle exact re-render), memory observed on the hooks kernel (mapped-backed regions + exact stack watermarks).
source_of_original_order: runtime/run.py run_one(): ready(desktop ready, terminal launch, initial prompt) -> sample_idle('ordinary-prompt-idle') -> streams() -> top_idle() -> phase('complete') + snapshot('complete'); and observer-s10-7/schedule-b2.json (b2-headless shared subset: initial-prompt, ordinary-prompt-idle, echo, ls, cat, ps, complete). The kept phases preserve that relative order.

how_the_b2_desktop_terminal_works.source: cells/apps/terminal/src/{main,session,grid}.rs at 3471028bc (worktree /tmp/cellbox-s10-7/worktree), compiled bytes verified (strings of signed /bin/terminal contain the banner and the builtin tables)
how_the_b2_desktop_terminal_works.mechanism: The GUI Terminal cell contains a self-contained builtin command interpreter (TerminalSession::execute_command): help, clear, uname, pwd, ls, ps, date, echo, exit; anything else prints `shell: command not found: <name>`. `ls` ignores its arguments and prints a fixed string, `ps` prints a fixed 9-row table, `date` a fixed date, `cat` does not exist. There is no exit status (`$?` is not expanded; `echo` prints its arguments verbatim). Commands never spawn a process: /bin/ls /bin/cat /bin/echo /bin/ps /bin/kill exist in the image but a typed line does not run them. The autoloaded /bin/shell cell (serial console, never typed into in a GUI-only run) is a separate task.
banner: Type 'help' for commands. Single-reader stream lease active.
initial_rows: Type 'help' for commands. Single-reader stream lease active.

geometry.grid: 80x26 cells in the cell, 79x26 drawn (column 80 does not fit the 720 px window)

how_the_b2_desktop_terminal_works.task_identification: terminal and shell are identified at their entry stops by byte equality of three 48-byte .text windows against the signed ELFs of the v2 image (hash-pinned against static-verification.json image.files); the terminal is the focus task (the GUI shell analogue); the shell is measured as a second task, not interacted with.
how_the_b2_desktop_terminal_works.oracle: the retained pixel oracle (Proof/Desk of phase04_gui_drive + phase10 Desk: glyph-binary exact re-render of the whole 720x480 window with the cursor cell masked, window located as the exact bbox of the Terminal background colour, cursor detector, one-character-change and previous-frame negative controls) is used unchanged. Only the EXPECTED rows differ: they are the literal strings of the B2 terminal source. libs/ostd typography/font/font_atlas, the font assets and libs/viui are byte-identical between the current tree (glyph oracle build) and the 3471028bc worktree, and the terminal render geometry/colours/clip equal the oracle's constants, so expected pixels are the guest's rasterization.

deadlines.note: original harness values, nothing raised or added for B2 desktop; the GUI-only per-input admission budget (5 s) and the 240/300/900 s boot and drawing waits of the retained desktop ready sequence are unchanged

idle.sampler: common.Surface.sample_idle (10 Hz target, whole-QEMU CPU ticks, GUI frame diff outside the cursor cell)

status.reason: The B2 GUI terminal has no exit status: `echo st=$?` would print the literal text `st=$?`, and select_status (fail closed on a missing st=<digits> row) cannot hold. Command completion is therefore judged by the exact-screen oracle (typed line exact, then one acceptable exact output screen with a fresh prompt) instead of a status row. No status probe is typed (it would add a shifted-key workload without a shared-command purpose; the select_status fail-closed behaviour on the expected B2 rows is proven offline).

phases.name: desktop-ready
phases.justification: Shared: the retained desktop ready sequence waits for `[desktop] Ready. Entering event loop.` (present in the B2 desktop serial log, boot smoke), pauses 3 s and checks the 1280x800 screen with no Terminal window.

phases.name: terminal-launch
phases.justification: Shared: Terminal launched by the taskbar click at the retained coordinates; waits for `[terminal] Terminal surface ready. Entering event loop.` (string present in the signed B2 terminal), then the Terminal window must appear as the exact 720x480 background bbox.

phases.name: initial-prompt
expect_rows: Type 'help' for commands. Single-reader stream lease active.
phases.justification: Shared: exact initial screen through the retained expect_screen + the two retained negative controls (window differs from the pre-launch screen by >1000 pixels, wrong-prompt `Cellos # ` differs by >=10 pixels) and the initial cursor cell check. Only the banner text differs from the Cellbox terminal (B2 prints its own banner).

phases.name: ordinary-prompt-idle
phases.justification: Shared: idle redraw at the prompt, 10 s x 100 samples, identical sampler (B2 redraws only on key events, so the GUI diff is expected to be zero).

phases.name: b2d-echo
phases.justification: Shared command `echo` (builtin of the B2 terminal and of the B2 shell); replaces the role of the original finite typed command.

phases.name: b2d-ls
phases.justification: Shared command `ls /`. The B2 GUI terminal answers with a FIXED string independent of its argument and of the VFS (session.rs); the row is recorded as exactly that comparator fact, not as a directory listing.

phases.name: b2d-cat
phases.justification: Shared command `cat` of an existing image file: the B2 GUI terminal has NO `cat`, so the exact expected outcome is its `command not found` line (session.rs execute_command default arm). Recorded as the B2 desktop comparator fact; this phase exercises the same typed-command path and keeps the shared-subset order.

phases.name: b2d-ps
phases.justification: Shared command `ps`: the B2 GUI terminal prints a FIXED nine-row table (session.rs), not a live process list.

phases.name: complete
phases.justification: Shared: final snapshot, as the original schedule.

on_phase_failure: STOP (no retry): an exact-screen mismatch/timeout, an input-admission failure or a memory wiring failure ends the run and is classified (C/D/E); nothing is re-driven. Unlike the headless B2 run there is no status row to tolerate: the oracle result IS the expected result.
